title: AI Weekly Digest: Key Developments
intro: This week in AI, significant policy, technical, and business updates emerged across the sector. Here are the most relevant news items to keep you informed.

items.heading: New York City Sets AI Policy for Children
items.body: New York City has introduced a policy focused on the use of artificial intelligence in contexts involving children. This move highlights growing attention to the ethical and societal impacts of AI, especially regarding minors and education.

items.heading: Anthropic Wins Court Ruling Amid Model Rights Dispute
items.body: Anthropic secured a court win related to model 'rights,' following criticism from Microsoft's AI leadership. This legal outcome underscores ongoing debates around intellectual property and control in the development and deployment of AI models.

items.heading: Nvidia Surpasses Estimates, AI Agent Expansion Noted
items.body: Nvidia exceeded financial expectations this week, reflecting strong demand for AI hardware and software. Additionally, the company is expanding its AI agent capabilities, signaling continued growth and innovation in autonomous systems.

items.heading: Meta's Acquisition of Moltbook Surfaces
items.body: Meta's purchase of Moltbook was reported among the latest AI news. This acquisition may indicate Meta's ongoing strategy to strengthen its AI portfolio and enhance its competitive position in the industry.
